h1: DJT Airport Car Service — Palm Beach | Onyx Executive Miami
a1: Private black-SUV transfers to and from President Donald J. Trump International Airport (DJT, formerly PBI) in West Palm Beach, with flight tracking.
l3: President Donald J. Trump International Airport
l7: Do I book under the DJT code or the old PBI code?
l8: Either works for the transfer itself — same airport, same terminal, same runways. Search whichever code your airline or booking site still shows; it makes no difference to pickup.
l9: Where at DJT / PBI do you meet arriving passengers?
l10: Curbside at arrivals by default, confirmed with you at booking. The terminal here is small enough that a meet-and-greet inside is rarely necessary, but it's available if you prefer it.
l11: How far is DJT / PBI from Aventura and Miami-Dade?
l12: It's the longest of the three airports we cover — figure roughly 55–70 minutes down to Aventura outside peak traffic. One chauffeur covers the whole corridor, so a trip that starts here and continues south stays with the same driver.
l13: Do you serve Palm Beach and Boca Raton directly from this airport?
l14: Yes. Palm Beach itself and Boca Raton are both short, routine runs from DJT — typically well under 30 minutes — well before continuing further south becomes relevant.
l15: Is a private chauffeur worth it for a smaller airport like this?
l16: It's arguably more useful here than at MIA or FLL — rideshare and taxi availability at DJT can be thinner outside peak hours, and a pre-arranged pickup removes that uncertainty entirely.
h5: Flight-tracked black-SUV pickups at Palm Beach's airport — curbside or at a pre-arranged meet-and-greet point inside the terminal, your chauffeur working to be ready when you land.
